_comment: Permanent blacklist. Any token whose deployer is listed in `wallets`, or
whose mint is listed in `mints`, scores 0 and is verdict SCAM/AVOID.
IMPORTANT — the two lists are not interchangeable:
wallets = the DEPLOYER/creator wallet that minted the token
mints   = the TOKEN contract address itself
Putting a mint in `wallets` silently never matches, which looks like
protection while providing none. post_mortem.mjs appends to `wallets`
automatically when a scanned token rugs.

wallets.reason: Deployer of $lighton — low-liquidity trap (MC ~$1.5k, sub-150 holders)

mints.reason: Low-liquidity trap. NOTE: this is the TOKEN mint, not a deployer wallet — it was originally supplied as a deployer address.
